title: I made a browser-based pokemon colosseum x super mario mod with Codex
author: yerbamate2020
selftext:
Having so much fun making mods of old childhood games :)

imo colosseum is the most underrated pokemon game  
  
[marcol.fun](http://marcol.fun)   
  
[https://x.com/0xRishi/status/2108611577062854663](https://x.com/0xRishi/status/2108611577062854663)

replies.author: Virtual-Analyst-4907
replies.body: I love that we grew up to be such karens and dont care. We literally turned this website into a miserable karen pit where everyone wants to be the hall monitor. Really inspiring.

replies.author: MilaKunisWatermelon
replies.body: He will get a cease & desist. Only if he makes money off it or refuses to take it down will he get sued.

replies.author: DocHolidayPhD
replies.body: That's actually not true. Using trademarked IP is enough to wind you up in court. Making money has nothing to do with it.

comments.author: Upper-Philosophy2376
comments.body: did you extract the models and animations from pokemon colesseum? I was curious about how to do that.

replies.author: yerbamate2020
replies.body: I just told codex in plain english what I wanted (pokemon colosseum but swap the pokemon with mario characters) so while I didn't do what you asked, Codex may have 😂
